name: User Preference Login Redirect
description: lets users choose their post-login redirect destination (an internal route) from their profile.
project_description:
The User Preference Login Redirect module allows users to select a custom redirect destination (route) after logging in. 

Administrators can configure a list of available routes and their labels via the module settings. Users can then choose their preferred redirect from their profile settings.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Configurable Login Redirect Routes: Define available routes and labels in the module settings.

 User Profile Setting: Users can select their preferred redirect destination on their profile page.

 Automatic Login Redirect: (If no ?destination parameter is present) Users are redirected to their chosen route after login.

 Permissions: Functionality can be limited to certain roles

 Back to top 

 Use Case 
 This module is useful for sites where users frequently need to navigate to specific pages after login, improving usability and workflow efficiency.

 Back to top 

 Similar projects 
 
 
 Login Destination : Allows setting a global redirect destination for users after login. Unlike this module, it does not allow users to select their preferred redirect destination individually.
 
 
 Redirect After Login : Provides a way to redirect users to a specific path after login, but does not support user-specific preferences.
 
 
 Login Redirect Per Role : Redirects users to different paths based on their roles, rather than individual user preferences.
 
 
 User Redirect : Offers role-based redirects and some user-specific redirects, but with a different configuration approach compared to this module.
 
 
 
 This module, User Preference Login Redirect , uniquely allows individual users to select their preferred redirect destination from their profile settings, providing a more personalized experience.
